rows.metric: Proposition 13 assessed-value annual increase cap; base tax rate
rows.note: Reassessment to market value on change of ownership or new construction (BOE Pub. 29). Holding preserves the cap; selling/exchanging resets it on the replacement property.

rows.metric: Section 1031 like-kind exchange scope
rows.value: Real property only (post-TCJA); gain deferred, not forgiven; basis carries over
rows.note: Qualified-intermediary and identification deadlines apply - confirm 45/180-day rules with tax counsel (Q-18). CA tax treatment must be confirmed separately.
